title: Extensions
summary: Official Derivative guide for Python Extensions on custom Components, covering extension setup, extension parameters, ownerComp, promoted members, dependable properties, StorageManager, ext/extensions access, and initialization and cleanup gotchas.
guidance: Use this article when a generated custom COMP needs Python state, promoted methods, dependable properties, or hidden persistent state beyond custom parameters.
Use ownerComp as the extension's reference back to the component that owns it.
Use TDF.createProperty() or StorageManager for dependable values that parameter expressions should update from.
Prefer ext access when members should remain unpromoted, and promote only capitalized methods or attributes that should appear directly on the component.
Guard parameter expressions with extensionsReady when an extension may still be initializing, and use onInitTD for work that must wait until the component is ready.
Use onDestroyTD to clean references during reinitialization when old extension objects might otherwise stay in memory.
